inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Franchise Tax Delinquent: The operation's Franchise Tax status is inactive.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Franchise Tax Delinquent (26 TAC §745.247)

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics: The director did not have training in the following topics for the previous training year (9/18/24 - 9/17/25):      *early brain development    *preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction   *building and physical premise safety    *handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics (26 TAC §746.1311(e))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Two caregivers did not have training in the following topics for their previous training year:    *early brain development   *preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction  *building and physical premise safety   *handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission: One child did not have a health statement on file.  One child's health statement did not include the name and address of a health-care professional who has examined the child within the past year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission (26 TAC §746.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Four children's records lacked the address for the listed emergency contact person.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: One caregiver only had 4 of the required 24 clock hours of training for the previous training year 3/23/25 - 3/24/26.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights: Parent rights that are consistent with the rules in Division 5 of this subchapter was not included in the operational policies during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §746.501(a)(20))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: The date, time, and length of time the drill took for the fire drills for February, March and May were not documented. This was corrected during the inspection when the director wrote down and back dated the days they completed these drills.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: The director did not have a current transportation safety training certificate available for review during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records: One caregiver's personnel file was unavailable for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §746.801(3))

occurrences.finding: Minimum Qualifications Child Care Center Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit: Two caregivers did not have a notarized Licensing Affidavit for Applicants for Employment in their files.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.1105(3))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Hand-washing Sink: There was not a hand washing sink or diaper changing station in the classroom with a child who is 17 months old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Hand-washing Sink (26 TAC §746.2405(4))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required: One caregiver's shaken baby syndrome, SIDS, and early childhood development training certificates were unavailable for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required (26 TAC §746.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records: The playground maintenance checks and building grounds were not documented for the previous two weeks. This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver filled out the days that the playground maintenance checks were conducted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records (26 TAC §746.801(8))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Adult-sized Chair: There was not a rocking chair in the classroom with a child who was 17 months old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Adult-sized Chair (26 TAC §746.2405(1))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: One caregiver's annual training hours were not complete.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: One child does not have a health statement or parent signature verifying that they have been examined by a health care professional in the past year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Notification of Change in Age Range of Children In Care: Operation was caring for infants without prior approval. Licensing did not approve operation to care for children 17 months and younger without the proper equipment being added.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Notification of Change in Age Range of Children In Care (26 TAC §746.301(5))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: Three ceiling tiles in the preschool classroom are damaged and in need of repair or replacement. (two  tiles have holes in them and one is warped and has exposed insulation).      There is a drain cover in the floor of the preschool classroom that has a soft spot & needs to be reinforced & the surrouncin tiles replaced or repaired.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: Out of two drivers, one was not current on the required annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Record of Pest Extermination: The operation did not have a record of a pest extermination available for review at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Record of Pest Extermination (26 TAC §746.801(17))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: One children with a documented medically diagnosed food allergy did not have a plan of action if the child ingested the food it was allergic to or a parent signature.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Caregivers did not have current training certificates available for review for the required training topic at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: One vechile did not have a current fire extinguisher. One fire extinguisher hanging near the kitchen had not been serviced since 2018.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: Out of two drivers, one was not current on the required annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit: The first aid kit in one vehicle was missing tweezers, the first aid guide and the band aids appeared old and deteriated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Driver Has Current Driver's License: The director did not have a current driver's license available for review at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Driver Has Current Driver's License (26 TAC §746.5617(b))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Caregivers did not have current training certificates available for review for the required training topic at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Out of six children files reviewed, three children did not have immunizations records available for review at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Several toys and furniture outside were broken and had sharp edges exposed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: The operation has not documented fire drills since January 2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: One children with a documented medically diagnosed food allergy did not have a plan of action if the child ingested the food it was allergic to or a parent signature.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Record of Pest Extermination: The operation did not have a record of a pest extermination available for review at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Record of Pest Extermination (26 TAC §746.801(17))

occurrences.finding: Electronic or Battery-Operated CO System-Document Tests, New Battery Installation and Name of Responsible Employee: There was no documentation that the system had been tested all year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic or Battery-Operated CO System-Document Tests, New Battery Installation and Name of Responsible Employee (26 TAC §746.5537(a)(4))
